$description: COPY-TO-CREATE-A-TENANT skeleton. This is the ENTIRE white-label surface — a tenant supplies only these ~dozen values and inherits the full semantic/component/chart system from _base. Steps to add a tenant: (1) copy this file to `<tenant>.json`; (2) fill brand.ramp (11 steps of the tenant's primary hue — keep 600 as the on-white solid, 700 AA for small text); (3) optionally set fonts/radius/accent; (4) if overriding chart.palette, replace the 8 categorical slots and RUN scripts/validate_palette.mjs (light+dark) — omit to inherit the safe default; (5) the build emits a `[data-theme="<tenant>"]` scope in dist/tokens.css. Null = inherit from base.

chart._note: To brand charts: replace with { "light": [8 hexes], "dark": [8 hexes] } and pass the validator. Otherwise leave as "inherit" — the generic default is already accessibility-gated.
